description:
You are a SOC analyst investigating an IDS alert. A packet capture containing suspicious activity mixed with legitimate traffic has been loaded in Wireshark (~/Documents/captures/recon_investigation.pcapng).

Your goal is to analyze the capture to identify a port scan, characterize it, and write a forensic report.

Required Forensic Report:
Create a text file at `~/Documents/scan_forensic_report.txt` containing the following fields (one per line, exact format):

SCANNER_IP: <IP address of the attacker>
TARGET_IP: <IP address of the victim>
SCAN_TYPE: <SYN, CONNECT, FIN, NULL, or XMAS>
TOTAL_PORTS_PROBED: <Total number of unique destination ports targeted by the scanner>
OPEN_PORTS: <Comma-separated list of ports that responded as OPEN (SYN-ACK), sorted ascending>
CLOSED_PORTS_COUNT: <Number of ports that responded as CLOSED (RST)>
BACKGROUND_PROTOCOL: <The application protocol used in the legitimate background traffic>

Note: The capture contains a mix of normal traffic and scanning. You must distinguish between them.
